verdict.rationale: Formant's on-device agent and Agent SDK ingest telemetry and sensor data and sync it to the cloud. Bandwidth-aware controls are documented first-party: per-stream rate limiting, configurable selection of which streams upload, a hard KBPS ceiling on asset uploads via FORMANT_UPLOAD_RATE_LIMIT_KBPS, and a low bandwidth mode. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of these bandwidth policies, and documentation of offline buffering or prioritization behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture sensor and telemetry data on-robot and sync it to the cloud with bandwidth-aware policies

citations.quote: The Agent SDK client contains a suite of methods which allow you to ingest telemetry data
You can configure which data sources and data streams are uploaded to the cloud.
Each data stream can be rate-limited, so you don't need to ingest data at high resolution if you don't need it.
Set `FORMANT_UPLOAD_RATE_LIMIT_KBPS` on the device to put a hard ceiling, in kilobits per second, on the agent's asset uploads
you can put the formant-agent in low bandwidth mode. This significantly reduces the amount of data the formant-agent uses for its passive duties
